headline: As of 2026-09-24: 150,270 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 9 of 50 states, D+41.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 150,270 early/mail ballots cast so far across 9 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+41.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (117,602), Wisconsin (13,449), North Carolina (9,424).
